blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Transport group Manibela called for immediate government action to support jeepney drivers and operators amid continuing oil price hikes in an open letter posted on social media on Sept. 22. Manibela chairman Mar Valbuena urged President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and other concerned government agencies to take concrete measures to protect the livelihoods of jeepney drivers affected by rising fuel prices. Valbuena said jeepney drivers are among those most directly affected by the oil price hikes.
